messages.subject: Dynamic update of plot height
parts:
For my http://glimmer.rstudio.com/awegro/RunningChase/ example I have tried to set the plot height based on the number of entries for the company and gender input from the ui.R (code below).

I've got the problem of when the plot updates the plot height does not automatically update. In Firefox I've found that I can manually refresh the page and it will correctly size the plot based on the height calculation. This doesn't work in Safari or IE though.

What's the best way to handle this? I could precalculate the entries and pass it along with the user input using a different data type but maybe there's a better way.

Thanks-

if (input$company == "ALL") { {
      p <- qplot(TotalTime/60,Name, data = subset(subset(x,Company == paste(input$company)),Gender != paste(input$variable,'')), color = Gender)+xlab("Minutes")+ylab("Runner")+ ggtitle(paste(input$company))
      print(p)
     }
  }, height = 60+as.integer(12*nrow(subset(subset(x,Company == paste(input$company)),Gender != paste(input$variable,'')))))
